decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric lost its own page in 2024 and is now only mentioned, a sign it falls short of aspiration, but it is close to the core offer and cheap to carry, so the firm keeps it for now.
The bouclé-effect decorative fabric has been mentioned steadily and fits the firm's broad collection, and since nothing signals a clear shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The flame-retardant jacquard kept its own page in both years and serves contract and hospitality demand, so it appears to meet aspiration and fits the firm's functional-textile strategy.
The wool-blend double-face fabric has steady website presence and its renewable wool fits the sustainability direction, though a hard-to-recycle blend could later be reconsidered.
The wool bouclé leno has stable presence and its renewable material aligns with the firm's sustainability goals, so it is retained within the collection.
The braided-structure fabric was launched recently with its own page, its results are still uncertain, and the firm's slack allows it to be carried while it builds sales.
